system.businessPurpose: Flag anomalous vendor invoices for human finance review before payment.
system.humanOversightDescription: Analysts must confirm every high-risk flag before payment holds are applied.

answers.overview-main-function: Scores invoices for anomaly risk and routes high-risk items to analysts.
answers.purpose-use-case: Reduce fraudulent or erroneous payments while keeping humans in the loop.
answers.data-sources-list: ERP invoice lines, vendor master data, historical payment outcomes.
answers.model-details-architecture: Gradient-boosted classifier with rule overlays and thresholding.
answers.risk-controls-mitigations: Threshold gates, dual-control for payment holds, monthly fairness review.
answers.oversight-escalation: Analysts can override scores and escalate to the risk committee.
answers.monitoring-approach: Weekly precision/recall dashboards and drift alerts on score distributions.
answers.incident-response-plan: Severity-based IR playbook with rollback of threshold changes.
answers.vendor-third-party-list: Cloud ERP connector and managed model hosting vendor.
answers.security-access-controls: SSO, role-based access, and immutable audit logs.
answers.change-management-process: Ticketed releases with offline eval gates before promotion.
